main-first-reviewed-train-next-batch-20260918
The first live daemon train succeeded. PRs 580 and 587 are merged on GitHub
at 09:35:34Z, publishing `21725def0609dafb1e183c4c0b150a1371b474d6`.
The retained manifest drops no member, publication reports no moved-ref
violations, both claims are released, and the runtime marker is done.

Verified first-parent commits:

- 580: `dab1f6526a5b11bbdfd977943d28757cc0fc47c6`, reviewed second parent
  `57da4a91db7b9336ff76705717409625f7597349`, `[lean +41 -1]`.
- 587: `21725def0609dafb1e183c4c0b150a1371b474d6`, reviewed second parent
  `1086ce4c9aa5febc5d5acf026753f03757d2ce4e`, `[lean +240 -0]`.

All eight combined CI steps passed in 436 seconds. MAIN supplied the
additional required rooted audit: 1662 PASS, zero FAIL, two existing
statement warnings. Normal publication hooks passed. The delta check uses
the published code-line policy, excluding blank/comment-only lines; an
initial operator comparison against physical line counts was corrected and
retained in the verification receipt. Issue 593 is closed with completion
comment 5728184176. Evidence: `native-audits/train580-587-first-20260918/`
and retained `~/.cache/mipstarre-dev/trains/train-fqvqk1pt/`.

This followed PR 595's daemon merge at 09:12:07Z as c0372326. Its refresh
retained all eight nontelemetry blobs and every added/removed byte; only
three existing event-log context lines differed. Independent assessment
5246047563 retained substantive approval 5245746090; all nine CI statuses
passed in 399s and rooted audit was 1660/0/2. The meta applied the reviewed
runtime patch and restarted the single PAR=0 daemon, PID 3945934.
MAIN supplied only the admitted JSON; it never invoked the publisher or
modified/restarted the runtime.

PR 597 had already merged at 08:34:12Z as 06ca834a, before the subsequent
595-first instruction. Its exact reviewed blob/parent and `[lean +140 -1]`
title were verified, issue 596 is closed, and the source marginal
point-annihilation proof is on main.

New exact-head review gates are green after published marker/actor/body,
APPROVED trailer, zero unchecked findings, all CI and rooted-audit checks:

| PR | Head | Review | CI seconds | Rooted PASS/FAIL/WARN |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 599 | 7c474162 | 5246139478 | 406 | 1660/0/3 |
| 601 | 85b9792f | 5246303210 | 376 | 1660/0/3 |
| 600 | 8e1c46b1 | 5246260120 | 385 | 1660/0/2 |
| 573 | ab8a2149 | 5246288661 | 374 | 1661/0/3 |
| 591 | ec639b67 | 5245739052 | 428 | 1660/0/3 |

MAIN accepts 600's complete proof of the unchanged `exists_ld_soundness`
after independent verification of the source-shaped game and proved
transport. Its three minor notes are pre-checked/nonblocking, not unresolved
findings. Printed-route gaps remain open under 527. Under the meta's
disposition, 542 is closed as superseded with the original audit preserved
by its immutable ac7cd808 provenance pointer; 600 is not yet claimed merged.
540 is KEEP: its obstruction evidence and existing local metadata fix remain
for publication/update after 601 integrates. 601 proves only the approximate
form with the explicit nonempty-answer boundary; exact attainment stays open.

573's fresh bounded assessment verifies that the sole refresh difference
adopts main's accurate projective-joint-measurement docstring; the remaining
contribution is byte-identical. Prior substantive approval 5238335551 remains
in force, without claiming strict hash-equal automatic carry. 591's valid
review and seven artifact hashes were completed before its dispatcher timed
out at 901s/exit124; that process failure and unknown usage tail are retained.
Its overwritten temporary readback incident did not affect the canonical
original publication/gate records.

The next batch is staged, in the meta's suggested order 599, 601, 600, 573,
591, at the full SHAs in `daemon/train-approved.json`. Live API evidence
reconfirmed every head, approval and all CI statuses; claims were free and
all five appeared clean in a complete 64-PR scan (15 candidates, 20.302s).
Evidence: `native-audits/train599-601-600-573-591-20260918/admission.jsonl`.
The daemon owns its next integration/publication. No second-batch merge
result is asserted here; MAIN again keeps primary telemetry quiet until
the transport ends and retains post-admission receipts outside primary.

Other dispositions: 503 is KEEP; an isolated ordinary merge against pinned
2e253049 reproduced no conflict, and only EVOLUTION context changes strict
patch identity. Original branch/worktree and all prior reviews are intact.
594's bounded blueprint F1 fix is published at e2396339, all 652 Lean files
unchanged; its new-head CI and bounded recheck remain next after the train.

Retired native task deltas this cycle (input/cached/output/reasoning):

- Gibbs, 594 fix: 465.230s; 2191758/2098560/17004/7309.
- Linnaeus, 503 disposition: 403.347s; 2323704/2187136/16522/5996.
- Faraday, 595 context: 197.247s; 1028951/963968/7487/1772.
- McClintock, 573 context: 346.749s across two turns including the deadline
  stop notice; 2113298/2003072/11969/3490.

Faraday exceeded its effective deadline by 12.625s and MAIN supplied the
mechanical receipt. McClintock published/read back before its deadline;
the final checksum finished two seconds late, and the complete episode
including MAIN's stop notice ended 46.870s beyond the deadline. Neither
overrun nor any earlier author/review cost was reset. The external 591
review's last observed delta is 2661586/2426880/20577/9982, with an unknown
unreported tail. Detailed terminal rows and rollouts remain canonical.

Ten completed helper spool rows were folded after the first train, with
70 exact semantic duplicates skipped and the spool retained unchanged.
The 08:04:20Z cycle snapshot is retained. No MAIN native, lane or CI job is
active. Relay-1 remains MAIN plus at most one native; space-3 has the single
authorized external slot; other keys remain retired. No #168 post occurred.
The formalization goal remains active.
